tools.name: pulse_list_requests
tools.description: List all Pulse API requests across collections and scratch.

tools.name: pulse_get_request
tools.description: Get the current or named Pulse request summary.

tools.name: pulse_get_response
tools.description: Get the latest response for a Pulse request.

tools.name: pulse_run_request
tools.description: Execute a Pulse request by id or name and return the response.

tools.name: pulse_import_curl
tools.description: Import a cURL command into Pulse as a new request.

tools.name: pulse_update_request
tools.description: Patch fields on a Pulse request (method, url, headers, body, auth, etc.).

tools.name: pulse_set_variable
tools.description: Set an environment variable in the active Pulse environment.

tools.name: pulse_list_variables
tools.description: List collection + environment variables for the active collection.

tools.name: pulse_save_tests
tools.description: Save a JavaScript validation script on a request.

tools.name: pulse_run_tests
tools.description: Run saved validation tests for a request (must have a last response).

tools.name: pulse_get_curl
tools.description: Export a request as a cURL command.

tools.name: pulse_json_path
tools.description: Read a JSON path from the latest response body.

tools.name: pulse_get_state
tools.description: Get high-level Pulse workspace state (collections, selected request, counts).

tools.name: pulse_create_request
tools.description: Create a blank or specified HTTP request in the active collection.
